pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygonal regions with softened, low-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry varies from jagged quadrilaterals on the mid-flank to more rounded, smaller tessellations toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways. The pathways exhibit relatively uniform thickness with frequent triple-junction nodes, creating a high-connectivity topological graph across the lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge along the nuchal crest. The silhouette against the sky shows a continuous, short-haired texture with minimal peak-to-trough variance.
